correctness.rationale: Write R(e1)=ae1+u, R(W)=h e1+A W. For u≠0, W components force scalar Q_R≡0 and all W-determinants vanish, so rank span(u,im A)<=2. The alternating two-form beta=det(u,.,.) induces on W/Ku a trace-zero rank<=1 map B; Au=cu and σ2(A)=c trB+detB=0, contradicting Q_R(e2,e3,e4)=σ2(A)+λ=0 at λ≠0. Thus u=0. Remaining only basis triple gives det A=a(σ2(A)+λ), with arbitrary h. Geometric irreducibility follows det and σ2+λ coprime and the equation primitive linear in a. For s=−λ≠0, H_q(s)=q³(q²+q+1)(q²−1), M_q(s)=q^8+χ_q(λ)q⁴ in odd characteristic; in even characteristic a trace-zero complement and Frobenius give M_q=q^8. Combining yields the proposed polynomial count and zeta. Independent direct all-ternary-identity enumeration of all 2^16 maps over F2 found 4736 solutions, all derived preserving. No finite enumeration substitutes for arbitrary-field proof.
